findings.apm_service_source: GPR_APM_MODULE_IID in include/dt-bindings/soc/qcom,gpr.h; ports 2/3/4 are PRM/AMDB/VCPM
findings.apm_command_header: audioreach_alloc_apm_cmd_pkt adds a 16-byte apm_cmd_header (payload address lsw/msw, mem map handle, payload size) even for GET_SPF_STATE
findings.linux_probe: q6apm_probe() calls q6apm_get_apm_state() but does not use its return value as a probe gate
findings.first_checked_apm_operation: q6apm_graph_open -> q6apm_send_cmd_sync(apm, open_pkt, 0) for APM_CMD_GRAPH_OPEN; audioreach_send_cmd_sync treats result.status > 0 as an error
findings.conclusion: GET_SPF_STATE is not a proven hard gate on Fuxi. ADSP_EFAILED is still an error and must not be reclassified as ready. A graph-open status 0 is the first Linux-checked APM success, but opening any graph needs explicit approval.

incident.request: 40-byte GPR header + 16-byte zero APM command header via gprSpfQuery

incident_diff.functional_difference: only the 16-byte APM command header and the 40-byte packet size; PAS/RSC/SMP2P/GLINK/amp code unchanged
incident_diff.observed: incident image reset to Fastboot before a DIAGSTATUS read; no panic line retained
incident_diff.hypothesis: the 40-byte zero-header GET_SPF_STATE is not accepted by this firmware and can destabilize the DSP/GLINK path; do not retry it without a separate stability investigation

next_validation.name: single-query muted SPF probe
next_validation.bounded: one 24-byte GET_SPF_STATE only; 1 s answer deadline; no retry loop
next_validation.reversible: fastboot boot only; no boot slot write; rollback image is R-GPR-06 or R-GLINK-01
next_validation.muted: amplifiers stay in reset/global mute; no I2C writes, no PCM, no graph
acceptance: CDC remains alive after the single query
SCM still 0x3f and SMP2P still ready
the single reply is recorded; ADSP_EFAILED stays a failure
if the reply is still EFAILED, stop and decide whether graph-open status 0 may be used as the next gate
not_allowed: open a speaker graph or unmute an amplifier before a separate approved gate

graph_selection.chosen: Fuxi AudioReach topology Xiaomi-13-tplg.bin, playback subgraph from facts/audio/binding.toml [path.graph]
graph_selection.why: It is the only Fuxi AudioReach APM configuration in the tree with concrete subgraph/container/module ids. The graph contains the Secondary MI2S speaker endpoint, so the test is GRAPH_OPEN only: no endpoint SET_CFG, no PCM format, no map, no prepare/start, no PCM, amplifiers held muted.

rejected.reason: q6voice Voice Call TX handset-mic graph, not APM AudioReach; cannot test APM_CMD_GRAPH_OPEN
q6voice Voice Call RX speaker graph; not APM and contains the speaker path

execution_envelope.one_graph_open: one APM_CMD_GRAPH_OPEN, one-second deadline, no retry
execution_envelope.no_followup: no SET_CFG, no shared-memory map, no GRAPH_PREPARE/START, no PCM
execution_envelope.close: one GRAPH_CLOSE only if the open returned status 0
execution_envelope.rollback: fastboot boot only; R-GPR-06 or R-GLINK-01
